sources.entry: Plot Factory - An online collaborative story planner that lets writers plan, organize, and write stories & fictional universes. #paid

summary.name: Plot Factory
summary.one_liner: Plot Factory is an online story planner for creating fictional universes, developing characters, and organizing plots before writing.
use_cases: collaborating on a story with others
writing a series with a consistent world
summary.what_it_does: ["Lets writers create fictional universes and organize the world and plot of a story before drafting. ", "Provides tools to forge detailed characters. ", "Supports planning, organizing and writing stories in one online place. ", "The Hacker-style listing describes it as a collaborative story planner, though the page text itself does not detail specific collaboration features. "]
notable: Online, browser-based story planning for fictional universes and characters
Positioned around planning stories before writing them
caveats: Listed with a #paid tag in the source list, but the page text itself does not state specific prices or tiers
Specific feature list and platform details are not stated on the page
